title: How This World Cup Changed Soccer

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: For the past few weeks, the world has been riveted by the drama of soccer's biggest tournament being played in Qatar, the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 过去几周，全世界都被在卡塔尔举办的足球界最大赛事——世界杯的戏剧性所吸引。

sentences.en: On Sunday, it culminated in a breathtaking win for Argentina and its star player, Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 周日，这场赛事以阿根廷队及其球星利昂内尔·梅西的惊人胜利画上了句号。

sentences.en: Today, I talked to my colleague Rory Smith about how the tournament's tainted beginnings were eclipsed by the thrill of the games,
sentences.zh: 今天，我与同事罗里·史密斯探讨了这场赛事充满争议的开局是如何被比赛的激情所掩盖的，

sentences.en: and why this World Cup may be an unsettling sign of things to come in professional soccer.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么这届世界杯可能是职业足球未来走向的一个令人不安的信号。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月19日，星期一。

sentences.en: Rory?
sentences.zh: 罗里？

sentences.en: Hey, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嘿，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: What's going on around you?
sentences.zh: 你周围发生了什么？

sentences.en: I hear a lot of sounds.
sentences.zh: 我听到很多声音。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I'm sitting outside the Lucille Iconic Stadium, the venue of the World Cup final.
sentences.zh: 是的，我现在坐在卢塞尔地标体育场外，这里是世界杯决赛的举办地。

sentences.en: I'm surrounded by a little battalion of kind of glazed-eyed policemen.
sentences.zh: 我被一小队眼神呆滞的警察包围着。

sentences.en: Who are, I suspect, at the end of their shift, and they're kind of going through what they've seen over the course of the evening.
sentences.zh: 我想他们应该是刚换班，正在回味今晚所见的一切。

sentences.en: There's an endless parade of journalists coming out of the stadium, milling around, all with an equally glazed expression.
sentences.zh: 无数记者正从体育场涌出，在周围徘徊，每个人都带着同样呆滞的表情。

sentences.en: And there's just the kind of detritus of the global media.
sentences.zh: 还有各种全球媒体留下的残余物。

sentences.en: There is the last few kind of...
sentences.zh: 还有最后一点……

sentences.en: Hey, detritus.
sentences.zh: 嘿，残余物。

sentences.en: What's who you're calling detritus?
sentences.zh: 你管谁叫残余物？

sentences.en: I include myself in that.
sentences.zh: 我也把自己算在内。

sentences.en: There are little groups of people who've worked in hospitality coming out, staff at the stadium leaving.
sentences.zh: 还有一些从事接待工作的人员正从体育场出来，工作人员正在离开。

sentences.en: You know, the game finished a couple of hours ago, but it's a big place, and there's a lot to do after games.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比赛几个小时前就结束了，但这是一个很大的地方，赛后还有很多事情要做。

sentences.en: So these are kind of the final few people starting to make their way home after the World Cup final.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人是世界杯决赛后最后一批开始回家的人。

sentences.en: You know, I was trying to prepare for this episode, Rory, and I kept hearing in the next room my husband, who was watching the game, shouting for joy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，罗里，我本来在为这期节目做准备，但我一直听到隔壁房间我丈夫在看比赛，他兴奋地大喊大叫。

sentences.en: He was just really, you know, making a lot of noise.
sentences.zh: 他真的，你知道，制造了很大的噪音。

sentences.en: And at some point I just gave on preparing for the episode because I thought I have to go in and watch the rest of the game.
sentences.zh: 后来我干脆放弃了准备工作，因为我觉得我必须进去看完剩下的比赛。

sentences.en: So it was really unbelievable, this game.
sentences.zh: 所以这场比赛真的令人难以置信。

sentences.en: Yeah, you couldn't help but be swept away by it.
sentences.zh: 是的，你无法不被它所感染。

sentences.en: Defending World Cup champs, France, led by Kylian Mbappe, squaring off against Lionel Messi's Argentina.
sentences.zh: 卫冕冠军法国队在基利安·姆巴佩的带领下，与利昂内尔·梅西的阿根廷队展开对决。

sentences.en: You have this kind of extraordinary story unfurling of Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 你看到了利昂内尔·梅西那段非凡的故事正在展开。

sentences.en: Messi scores!
sentences.zh: 梅西进球了！

sentences.en: Everything seems to be smooth sailing, but World Cups in general are never smooth sailings.
sentences.zh: 一切似乎都很顺利，但世界杯通常从来都不是一帆风顺的。

sentences.en: Pedaling for France, 12 minutes to go.
sentences.zh: 法国队在最后12分钟奋起直追。

sentences.en: So France come back, and in two minutes everything falls apart.
sentences.zh: 所以法国队回来了，两分钟内一切都崩塌了。

sentences.en: Then you have the tension of the last few minutes of the game as France try and find a winning goal.
sentences.zh: 然后是比赛最后几分钟的紧张时刻，法国队试图寻找制胜球。

sentences.en: The French have been down and out, and they have risen back.
sentences.zh: 法国队一度陷入绝境，但他们又站了起来。

sentences.en: Argentina are on the brink of a sort of national scarring, really, something that would haunt them for years.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷队处于一种国家级创伤的边缘，真的，那会困扰他们多年。

sentences.en: They make it to extra time.
sentences.zh: 他们进入了加时赛。

sentences.en: Messi scores what everybody assumes is the winning goal, what he assumes is the winning goal, what the fans in the stands assume is the winning goal.
sentences.zh: 梅西打进了所有人认为的制胜球，他自己也认为是制胜球，看台上的球迷也认为是制胜球。

sentences.en: Then the French go and score again, so you have penalties.
sentences.zh: 然后法国队又进球了，所以进入了点球大战。

sentences.en: And then a penalty shootout is the most exquisite sort of torture anyone has ever come up with in sport, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为点球大战是体育史上最精致的折磨方式。

sentences.en: So painful.
sentences.zh: 太痛苦了。

sentences.en: He said, I dare you to go there, and Mbappe says, I will.
sentences.zh: 他说，我敢让你去踢，姆巴佩说，我会的。

sentences.en: Rolls it in.
sentences.zh: 球滚进了网窝。

sentences.en: You know there are going to be one or two or three extremely unfortunate villains through no real fault of their own.
sentences.zh: 你知道会有那么一两个或三个人成为极其不幸的罪人，尽管这并非他们的错。

sentences.en: And then this curiosity of World Cups, you know, that soccer isn't scripted, and that's its glory, like all sports.
sentences.zh: 还有世界杯的这种奇妙之处，你知道，足球不是按剧本演的，这就是它的荣耀，就像所有体育运动一样。

sentences.en: Gonzalo Montiel can win the World Cup for Argentina with this kick.
sentences.zh: 贡萨洛·蒙铁尔可以用这脚球为阿根廷赢得世界杯。

sentences.en: So a guy called Gonzalo Montiel, who's a relatively unheralded, but obviously quite successful right-back, steps up to take the kick that echoes through history.
sentences.zh: 所以一个叫贡萨洛·蒙铁尔的人，一个相对不出名但显然非常成功的右后卫，走上前去踢出了载入史册的一球。

sentences.en: He scores.
sentences.zh: 他进球了。

sentences.en: Just three all after two hours, Argentina beat France in a penalty shootout.
sentences.zh: 两小时后比分是3比3，阿根廷队在点球大战中击败了法国队。

sentences.en: The Argentine end melts into delirium and jubilation and this sort of sea of humanity.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷球迷区陷入了狂喜和欢庆，变成了一片人的海洋。

sentences.en: Argentina, you can cry, you can cry tears of joy from Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷，你可以哭，你可以为利昂内尔·梅西流下喜悦的泪水。

sentences.en: Messi collapses to his knees, and Argentina, for the third time, for the first time in 36 years, are champions of the world.
sentences.zh: 梅西跪倒在地，阿根廷队时隔36年第三次成为世界冠军。

sentences.en: A moment that cements his legacy as the greatest of all time.
sentences.zh: 这一刻巩固了他作为史上最伟大球员的地位。

sentences.en: And Lionel Messi, arguably the greatest player who's ever lived, has the one trophy that had always alluded him.
sentences.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西，可以说是史上最伟大的球员，终于拿到了那座一直与他无缘的奖杯。

sentences.en: Were you like, in one word, what were you feeling?
sentences.zh: 如果用一个词，你当时是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I don't think I'm allowed to say that word on the daily.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在《每日新闻》节目里我不能说那个词。

sentences.en: I think that would be very offensive to all concerned.
sentences.zh: 我想那对所有相关人员都会非常冒犯。

sentences.en: Okay, fair enough, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，有道理，有道理。

sentences.en: I was totally swept up in the Messi story because he's the player of my lifetime, and I feel genuinely privileged to have seen him play in the flesh, and I felt he deserved it.
sentences.zh: 我完全沉浸在梅西的故事中，因为他是我这一代人的球员，我感到非常荣幸能亲眼看到他踢球，我觉得他当之无愧。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I was impartial because I'm a reporter, but this felt like the right ending.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我保持中立是因为我是记者，但这感觉像是正确的结局。

sentences.en: So, Rory, when the World Cup first started, we had our colleague Tarek Panja on the show, and we left the conversation with Tarek asking the question,
sentences.zh: 那么，罗里，当世界杯刚开始时，我们的同事塔雷克·潘贾在节目中，我们离开时塔雷克提出了一个问题，

sentences.en: what would the world remember about this World Cup?
sentences.zh: 世界会记住这届世界杯的什么？

sentences.en: Like, would we remember the migrants who died to build the stadiums and build the infrastructure to hold it?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们会记住那些为了建造体育场和基础设施而死去的移民吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, now I think we can pretty confidently say that most people will remember this World Cup for the win of Argentina, of Messi, and not really, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在我想我们可以相当自信地说，大多数人会因为阿根廷和梅西的胜利而记住这届世界杯，而不是，你知道，

sentences.en: the abuses leading up to it.
sentences.zh: 那些导致这一切的虐待行为。

sentences.en: Yeah, you have this dual narrative, don't you, of Messi's incredible journey at the age of 35 to the trophy that he's wanted for his entire career that seemed to have eluded him,
sentences.zh: 是的，你有这种双重叙事，不是吗？梅西在35岁时实现了他整个职业生涯梦寐以求却似乎一直与他无缘的奖杯，

sentences.en: in addition to the most remarkable final of all time.
sentences.zh: 再加上史上最精彩的决赛。

sentences.en: And to be honest, it seemed unlikely at the start of the tournament that that would be how this whole thing ended, because those first couple of weeks, as you probably remember,
sentences.zh: 老实说，在比赛开始时，这似乎不太可能是最终的结局，因为正如你可能记得的那样，前几周，

sentences.en: were dominated by what I'm sure the Qataris would refer to as teething probleMs.
sentences.zh: 被卡塔尔人所说的“成长阵痛”所主导。

sentences.en: We had the issue over whether beer could be sold in stadiuMs.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了关于体育场内是否可以售卖啤酒的问题。

sentences.en: There were fans who were turned away from games because they were wearing T-shirts or hats or whatever it might be with rainbows on them.
sentences.zh: 有些球迷因为穿着印有彩虹图案的T恤或帽子等而被拒绝入场。

sentences.en: And that was seen as trying to promote LGBT rights.
sentences.zh: 这被视为试图推广LGBT权利。

sentences.en: We had the contretemps over whether certain European teams would be allowed to wear an armband.
sentences.zh: 我们还就某些欧洲球队是否被允许佩戴袖标发生了争执。

sentences.en: And it seemed as though FIFA and Qatar were really determined to stamp their authority on the tournament, to make it the World Cup as they wanted it to be,
sentences.zh: 看起来国际足联和卡塔尔真的决心在比赛中确立他们的权威，按照他们想要的方式举办世界杯，

sentences.en: without any of these pesky questions over equality and human rights.
sentences.zh: 没有任何关于平等和人权的讨厌问题。

sentences.en: But in doing so, it felt a lot like they were drawing more attention to those issues.
sentences.zh: 但这样做，感觉他们反而让人们更加关注这些问题了。

sentences.en: And really, what got them out of that mess that they themselves had kind of made was the sport.
sentences.zh: 实际上，让他们摆脱这种自找麻烦的，是体育本身。

sentences.en: That once the World Cup gets underway, the eyes of the soccer community, in particular, are drawn to the games themselves.
sentences.zh: 一旦世界杯开始，足球界的目光，特别是，就被吸引到了比赛本身。

sentences.en: So early on in the tournament, here at Lusail, in fact, you had one of the biggest shocks in World Cup history when Saudi Arabia beat Argentina,
sentences.zh: 所以在比赛初期，事实上就在卢塞尔，发生了世界杯历史上最大的冷门之一，沙特阿拉伯击败了阿根廷，

sentences.en: which was, you know, looking back now, seems remarkable, and at the time was jaw-dropping.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，这看起来很了不起，当时简直让人目瞪口呆。

sentences.en: That result kind of set the tone for the first 10 days, certainly, of the tournament,
sentences.zh: 那个结果为比赛的前10天定下了基调，当然，

sentences.en: when it was followed by Japan beating Germany in this remarkable five-minute turnaround and then doing exactly the same thing against Spain.
sentences.zh: 随后是日本队在五分钟内逆转击败德国队，然后对阵西班牙队时也做了同样的事情。

sentences.en: It just felt like the rules were all upside down, like gravity had ceased to apply to, like, all of these teaMs.
sentences.zh: 感觉规则全乱了，就像重力对所有这些球队都不再起作用了一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, and after a while, we started to see the ultimate example of this in Morocco.
sentences.zh: 是的，过了一会儿，我们开始在摩洛哥队身上看到了这种极致的例子。

sentences.en: Nobody had really seen Morocco as a contender in this World Cup.
sentences.zh: 没人真的把摩洛哥视为这届世界杯的竞争者。

sentences.en: And then the turning point was they beat Belgium.
sentences.zh: 然后转折点是他们击败了比利时队。

sentences.en: A win or even a tie against Canada on Thursday, and Morocco moves on.
sentences.zh: 周四对阵加拿大队只要赢球甚至平局，摩洛哥就能晋级。

sentences.en: If Morocco beat Canada, they would win the group.
sentences.zh: 如果摩洛哥击败加拿大，他们将赢得小组第一。

sentences.en: Morocco not only advances.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥不仅晋级了。

sentences.en: Kobe, they win the group.
sentences.zh: 科比，他们赢得了小组第一。

sentences.en: Morocco duly did that, and that tees up what looks like a slightly unfortunate last-16 game with Spain,
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥确实做到了，这为他们对阵西班牙的16强赛做好了准备，看起来有点不幸，

sentences.en: one of the big names in European soccer, one of the pre-tournament favorites, a team full of established stars.
sentences.zh: 欧洲足球的大牌之一，赛前夺冠热门之一，一支满是成名球星的球队。

sentences.en: But Morocco, through a mix of intensity and grit and refusal to lose, and no shortage of talent,
sentences.zh: 但摩洛哥凭借强度、毅力、永不言败的精神，以及不俗的天赋，

sentences.en: held the Spanish to a draw, took them to penalties, and beat them.
sentences.zh: 将西班牙队逼平，拖入点球大战，并击败了他们。

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 不可思议。

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 不可思议。

sentences.en: Which suddenly takes Morocco into the quarterfinals of the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 这突然把摩洛哥带入了世界杯四分之一决赛。

sentences.en: Part of it is confidence, right?
sentences.zh: 部分原因是自信，对吧？

sentences.en: You beat some of those opponents, your confidence continues to build.
sentences.zh: 你击败了一些对手，你的自信心就会不断增强。

sentences.en: Listen, I don't rule them out in a quarterfinal match against Portugal.
sentences.zh: 听着，我不排除他们在四分之一决赛中击败葡萄牙的可能性。

sentences.en: And at that stage, they run into Portugal.
sentences.zh: 在那个阶段，他们遇到了葡萄牙。

sentences.en: And again, the Moroccans beat them.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥人再次击败了他们。

sentences.en: And in that moment, Morocco, this unheralded team, become the first African side ever to make the World Cup semifinals.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，摩洛哥这支默默无闻的球队，成为了第一支打进世界杯半决赛的非洲球队。

sentences.en: That's powerful enough.
sentences.zh: 这已经足够震撼了。

sentences.en: But what gives it a real resonance is that Morocco aren't just an African team.
sentences.zh: 但真正引起共鸣的是，摩洛哥不仅仅是一支非洲球队。

sentences.en: They're a North African team.
sentences.zh: 他们是一支北非球队。

sentences.en: They identify largely as Arab.
sentences.zh: 他们很大程度上认同自己是阿拉伯人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You had Tunisians supporting Morocco.
sentences.zh: 有突尼斯人支持摩洛哥。

sentences.en: You had Egyptians supporting Morocco.
sentences.zh: 有埃及人支持摩洛哥。

sentences.en: The Lebanese supported Morocco.
sentences.zh: 黎巴嫩人支持摩洛哥。

sentences.en: There were celebrations in Amman and Cairo and Tunis and Riyadh for Morocco's success.
sentences.zh: 安曼、开罗、突尼斯和利雅得都为摩洛哥的成功举行了庆祝活动。

sentences.en: And given that this is the first World Cup to be held in the Middle East, to be held in a Muslim-majority nation, to be held in an Arabian country,
sentences.zh: 考虑到这是第一届在中东举办的世界杯，在穆斯林占多数的国家举办，在阿拉伯国家举办，

sentences.en: that gave Morocco's story a tremendous power.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了摩洛哥的故事巨大的力量。

sentences.en: This is the first time, and I am so happy that we live this moment now in Qatar.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，我很高兴我们现在在卡塔尔经历了这一刻。

sentences.en: And what I can say, it's unbelievable to me, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我能说的是，这对我来说难以置信。

sentences.en: Morocco became this real symbol, right?
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥成为了一个真正的象征，对吧？

sentences.en: This force for unity for Arab countries and African countries, even if ultimately they didn't end up making it to the final.
sentences.zh: 这种阿拉伯国家和非洲国家的团结力量，即使他们最终没能进入决赛。

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣。

sentences.en: It feels slightly intangible and a bit ethereal.
sentences.zh: 感觉有点无形，有点飘渺。

sentences.en: They were representing, and they felt like they were representing,
sentences.zh: 他们代表着，他们感觉自己代表着，

sentences.en: Africa and the Arab world, and they were doing it in an Arab country at the first Arab World Cup.
sentences.zh: 非洲和阿拉伯世界，而且他们是在一个阿拉伯国家举办的第一届阿拉伯世界杯上做到的。

sentences.en: So, going back to our question about Qatar,
sentences.zh: 所以，回到我们关于卡塔尔的问题，

sentences.en: I mean, this is kind of an interesting moment, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个有趣的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, they're the first Arab country to host, and here you have this kind of Cinderella story about an Arab team.
sentences.zh: 他们是第一个举办世界杯的阿拉伯国家，而这里有一个关于阿拉伯球队的灰姑娘故事。

sentences.en: It sounds like this is exactly what Qatar would have wanted.
sentences.zh: 听起来这正是卡塔尔想要的。

sentences.en: Yes and no.
sentences.zh: 既是也不是。

sentences.en: I think it was definitely welcomed by the Qataris as a people that there was an Arab team doing so well.
sentences.zh: 我认为卡塔尔人民肯定欢迎有一支阿拉伯球队表现得如此出色。

sentences.en: But there comes a point where people are watching the soccer, and the story that people were watching was Morocco.
sentences.zh: 但当人们观看足球比赛时，人们关注的故事是摩洛哥。

sentences.en: And it felt a little bit at times like the first Arab World Cup was becoming less about Qatar and more about Morocco.
sentences.zh: 有时感觉第一届阿拉伯世界杯似乎不再是关于卡塔尔，而是关于摩洛哥。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: On the one hand, of course, these underdog narratives are what Qatar wanted, because the spotlight has shifted away from, you know, the stain of the migrant deaths.
sentences.zh: 一方面，当然，这些黑马叙事是卡塔尔想要的，因为聚光灯已经从移民死亡的污点上移开了。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it's Morocco and Messi who got the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，是摩洛哥和梅西抢走了聚光灯。

sentences.en: Not Qatar, right?
sentences.zh: 不是卡塔尔，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, who really cares at the end of the day who hosted the World Cup after you watched this final?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看完这场决赛后，谁真的在乎是谁举办了世界杯？

sentences.en: No one, right?
sentences.zh: 没人，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, and for most people, obviously, the World Cup is a TV spectacle.
sentences.zh: 是的，对大多数人来说，世界杯显然是一场电视奇观。

sentences.en: It doesn't really matter where it is.
sentences.zh: 在哪里举办并不重要。

sentences.en: But both for Qatar and for the sport itself, the things that have captivated the view in public are really only one aspect of the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 但对于卡塔尔和这项运动本身来说，吸引公众眼球的事情实际上只是世界杯的一个方面。

sentences.en: There's a lot more at stake here than just which storylines are unfurling on the pitch.
sentences.zh: 这里涉及的不仅仅是球场上展开的故事线。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So I should warn you that, and this happens a lot in Qatar, there's just some fireworks going off.
sentences.zh: 我应该提醒你，在卡塔尔经常发生这种情况，外面正在放烟花。

sentences.en: There's kind of the most amazing New Year's display of fireworks you've ever seen just in the sky over there for reasons no one's really clear about.
sentences.zh: 那边天空中有着你见过的最惊人的新年烟花表演，没人清楚原因。

sentences.en: Fireworks because you're halfway done with our episode.
sentences.zh: 放烟花是因为我们的节目进行了一半。

sentences.en: It might be that, yeah.
sentences.zh: 可能是那样，是的。

sentences.en: Well, I think they'd probably save the best of them until we've finished.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想他们可能会把最好的留到我们结束之后。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Rory, if most of the world moves on and forgets about Qatar,
sentences.zh: 那么，罗里，如果世界上大多数人继续前行，逐渐淡忘卡塔尔，

sentences.en: what's in it for them at the end of all of this?
sentences.zh: 这一切结束后，他们能从中得到什么呢？

sentences.en: Like, why do it in the first place?
sentences.zh: 比如，当初为什么要举办呢？

sentences.en: There were several different strands of logic behind it, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，这背后有几条不同的逻辑线索。

sentences.en: Part of that is domestic.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分是国内因素。

sentences.en: You know, we've seen in Doha and in Lusail, which are separate cities, not just whole neighbourhoods spring out from the ground, but an entire place.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在多哈和卢塞尔看到了，它们是独立的城市，不仅仅是整个街区从地面拔地而起，而是一整座城市。

sentences.en: Lusail did not exist 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 卢塞尔在10年前根本不存在。

sentences.en: And kind of away to my left now, I can see these four soaring towers, which will be the home of the country's Sovereign Wealth Fund and Qatar National Bank.
sentences.zh: 现在在我左手边，我可以看到这四座高耸入云的塔楼，它们将成为该国主权财富基金和卡塔尔国家银行的所在地。

sentences.en: They're surrounded by apartment blocks that are currently empty, but which are meant to attract 250,000 people.
sentences.zh: 它们被目前空置的公寓楼所环绕，但这些公寓旨在吸引25万人口。

sentences.en: And there's an Argentinian man shouting.
sentences.zh: 那边还有个阿根廷人在大喊大叫。

sentences.en: So the face of Qatar has changed drastically in the last 10 years because of the huge construction project that hosting the World Cup entailed.
sentences.zh: 所以，由于举办世界杯带来的巨大建设项目，卡塔尔的面貌在过去10年里发生了翻天覆地的变化。

sentences.en: But it's also changed Qatari society a little bit, I think.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这也稍微改变了卡塔尔的社会。

sentences.en: I spoke to someone early on in the tournament who said that the reason people think Doha is boring is because there isn't that much to do in Doha,
sentences.zh: 我在锦标赛初期和一个人聊过，他说人们觉得多哈无聊的原因是多哈没什么可做的，

sentences.en: or there didn't used to be that much to do in Doha.
sentences.zh: 或者说过去多哈没什么可做的。

sentences.en: Whereas now in Meshereb, which is the kind of downtown district that has been revamped and refurbished for this tournament,
sentences.zh: 而现在在姆什莱布，也就是为了这次锦标赛而翻新改造的市中心区域，

sentences.en: there are hipster coffee bars, there are trendy barbers.
sentences.zh: 有文青咖啡馆，有时尚理发店。

sentences.en: You know, there's all the accoutrements of those premium developments that you see in London and New York and everywhere else.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在伦敦、纽约和其他任何地方看到的那些高端开发项目的配套设施，这里应有尽有。

sentences.en: And are people using them, Rory?
sentences.zh: 罗里，人们真的在用这些设施吗？

sentences.en: Well, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: And obviously, for the most part during the tournament, it's been visitors.
sentences.zh: 显然，在锦标赛期间，大部分使用者都是游客。

sentences.en: It's been the people who've come from all over the world and particularly from the Middle East and North Africa who've been using those coffee bars, those restaurants.
sentences.zh: 是那些从世界各地，特别是从中东和北非赶来的人们在使用这些咖啡馆和餐厅。

sentences.en: But it's been Qatari's too.
sentences.zh: 但卡塔尔人也在用。

sentences.en: That's been really noticeable.
sentences.zh: 这一点非常明显。

sentences.en: And obviously, we can't say this with any certainty now, but you do wonder whether
sentences.zh: 显然，我们现在还不能确定，但你确实会好奇，

sentences.en: that will be something of a shift for Qatari's.
sentences.zh: 这是否会成为卡塔尔人的一种转变。

sentences.en: That, you know, if they have places to go to, if you want to go into a San Francisco-style coffee bar in Doha, now you can.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果他们有了去处，如果你想在多哈去一家旧金山风格的咖啡馆，现在你可以去了。

sentences.en: And having that option may well make Doha a more vibrant, more lively city.
sentences.zh: 拥有这种选择很可能会让多哈成为一个更有活力、更生动的城市。

sentences.en: So there may well be some sort of long-standing impact of the World Cup on the way that Qataris live their lives.
sentences.zh: 所以世界杯很可能会对卡塔尔人的生活方式产生某种长远的影响。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: And what about outside Qatar?
sentences.zh: 那卡塔尔之外呢？

sentences.en: Like, that's domestic.
sentences.zh: 那是国内的情况。

sentences.en: What about the world?
sentences.zh: 世界又是怎么看的？

sentences.en: Well, that, I think, is the central purpose of why the World Cup has been here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这正是世界杯在这里举办的核心目的。

sentences.en: And that's probably why the impact on the Soccer View in public will be relatively low down Qatar's list of priorities.
sentences.zh: 这也可能就是为什么公众对足球的看法在卡塔尔的优先事项清单中排名相对靠后的原因。

sentences.en: Qatar's a very rich place in a very dangerous neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔是一个处于非常危险地带的极其富裕的国家。

sentences.en: You've got Saudi Arabia on one side, Iran on the other, and this tiny country that has the world's third largest proven reserves of natural gas sitting in the middle.
sentences.zh: 你一边是沙特阿拉伯，另一边是伊朗，而这个拥有世界第三大天然气探明储量的小国就坐落在中间。

sentences.en: Qatar kind of needed to announce itself to the world.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔需要向世界宣告自己的存在。

sentences.en: It needed to become the sort of place that people think about, that people consider as an established global player.
sentences.zh: 它需要成为人们会去思考、会将其视为一个成熟的全球参与者的地方。

sentences.en: And from Qatar's point of view, this tournament has been an enormous success.
sentences.zh: 从卡塔尔的角度来看，这次锦标赛取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: There's been the kind of obvious stuff whereby you've seen this parade of global leaders, both political and in the corporate world,
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，你看到了全球政界和商界领袖的纷至沓来，

sentences.en: come through Qatar, you know, not just for meetings, but just to see and be seen.
sentences.zh: 他们来到卡塔尔，你知道，不仅仅是为了开会，更是为了露面和被看见。

sentences.en: We had Antony Blinken, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们接待了美国国务卿安东尼·布林肯。

sentences.en: Secretary of State.
sentences.zh: 我们还接待了贾里德·库什纳，我想他已经来过两次了。

sentences.en: We've had Jared Kushner, who I think has now been twice.
sentences.zh: 决赛时，他和推特及特斯拉的老板埃隆·马斯克坐在同一个包厢里。

sentences.en: He was in a corporate box for the final with Elon Musk, the owner of Twitter and Tesla.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 我们还接待了法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙。

sentences.en: And we had Emmanuel Macron, the French president.
sentences.zh: 我们还看到了一连串来自邻国的政客。

sentences.en: And we've also seen a succession of politicians from nearby.
sentences.zh: 所以沙特阿拉伯王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼出席了开幕式，坐在离卡塔尔埃米尔很近的地方，而就在几年前，

sentences.en: So Mohammed bin Salman, the crown prince of Saudi Arabia, was at the opening ceremony, sitting very close to the Emir of Qatar, which just a couple of years ago,
sentences.zh: 当沙特领导对卡塔尔的封锁时，这看起来是完全不可想象的。

sentences.en: when Saudi was leading a blockade of Qatar, would have seemed completely unthinkable.
sentences.zh: 我们还有土耳其总统出席了比赛。

sentences.en: We've had the president of Turkey attend games.
sentences.zh: 还有约旦王室的代表。

sentences.en: They've been representatives from the Jordanian royal family.
sentences.zh: 有时感觉就像沙漠里的达沃斯论坛，这是一个人们展示权力并与其他权贵会面的地方。

sentences.en: It has felt at times a little bit like a kind of Davos in the desert, that this is a place where people come to display their power and to meet with other powerful people.
sentences.zh: 我认为卡塔尔很享受扮演这个角色。

sentences.en: And I think Qatar has reveled in playing that role.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这突显了举办世界杯的主要好处之一，那就是一种感觉——虽然它感觉有些抽象和模糊，

sentences.en: And that, I think, has accentuated one of the main benefits of hosting the World Cup, which is the sense that, and it feels intangible and a little bit woolly,
sentences.zh: 但这种感觉就是卡塔尔现在是一个人们听说过的地方。

sentences.en: but it's the sense that Qatar is now a place that people have heard of.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在董事会里，如果你是一位企业领袖，如果你试图与卡塔尔做生意，

sentences.en: So if you're in a boardroom, if you're a corporate leader, if you're trying to do business with Qatar,
sentences.zh: 没有理由去怀疑或猜忌它，也不会觉得它太陌生或太遥远。

sentences.en: there's no reason to be, not skeptical or suspicious of it, but to find it too foreign or too distant.
sentences.zh: 就像，那是卡塔尔。

sentences.en: Like, it's Qatar.
sentences.zh: 它举办过世界杯。

sentences.en: It hosted the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 我们认识那些人。

sentences.en: We know those guys.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对卡塔尔寻求确立自己作为外交参与者、政治参与者和商业中心地位具有难以置信的价值。

sentences.en: And I think that has an incredible value to Qatar as it seeks to establish itself as a diplomatic player, as a political player, as a place to do business.
sentences.zh: 它不再像过去那样陌生了。

sentences.en: It's not quite as foreign as it once was.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以换句话说，即使普通足球迷未来可能不会把卡塔尔放在心上，但全球领袖、各界名流和首席执行官们

sentences.en: So, in other words, even if, you know, the average soccer fan might not have Qatar at top of mind, moving forward, global leaders and kind of movers and shakers and CEOs
sentences.zh: 对这个国家有了新的认识。

sentences.en: have a new appreciation for the country.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，如果说有什么全球认可的印章，这就是了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, if ever there was a stamp of global approval, this was it.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 举办世界杯意味着你被接纳了。

sentences.en: Having the World Cup says you belong.
sentences.zh: 我认为，即使公众对足球的看法仍保留着一些关于这届世界杯充满争议、付出代价

sentences.en: I think even if the soccer view in public retains some muscle memory of this World Cup being controversial or this World Cup coming at a cost
sentences.zh: 或在某些方面存在问题的肌肉记忆，但从卡塔尔的角度来看，这种代价被世界杯带来的光环、魅力

sentences.en: or this World Cup being in some way problematic, that cost is massively offset from a Qatari point of view by the benefit of the luster and the glamour
sentences.zh: 以及由此获得的认可所带来的好处极大地抵消了。

sentences.en: and the acceptance that having the World Cup bestowed.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 但当然，卡塔尔和卡塔尔官员并不是唯一在这件事上投入了大量金钱和声誉的人，对吧？

sentences.en: But, of course, Qatar and Qatari officials aren't the only ones with tons of money and reputation riding on this, right?
sentences.zh: 还有国际足联，这项运动的全球管理机构。

sentences.en: There's also FIFA, the sport's global governing body.
sentences.zh: 那么他们对这一切感觉如何？

sentences.en: So how are they feeling about all of this?
sentences.zh: 哦，国际足联过得非常愉快。

sentences.en: Oh, FIFA have had an absolutely great time.
sentences.zh: 国际足联再满意不过了。

sentences.en: FIFA could not be happier in any way.
sentences.zh: 他们周五表示，在上届世界杯和本届世界杯之间的四年周期里，他们赚了75亿美元。

sentences.en: They have made, they said on Friday, $7.5 billion over the course of the four-year cycle between the last World Cup and this one.
sentences.zh: 其中包括10亿美元的超额利润。

sentences.en: That includes a billion dollars in excess profit.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 所以国际足联，是的，这对国际足联来说进展得还不错。

sentences.en: So FIFA, yeah, this has gone okay for FIFA.
sentences.zh: 但几乎同样重要的是锦标赛的结构。

sentences.en: But almost as important as that is the kind of fabric of the tournament.
sentences.zh: 几年前，后来身败名裂的国际足联高官杰罗姆·瓦尔克曾随口评论说，过多的民主对国际足联来说可能是个问题。

sentences.en: A few years ago, Jerome Valker, who was a bigwig in FIFA, who was later disgraced, made an off-the-cuff comment saying that too much democracy can be a problem for FIFA.
sentences.zh: 因为国际足联喜欢在世界杯期间抵达一个国家，圈占领地，制定自己的规则，用自己的标志和赞助商覆盖一切，

sentences.en: Because what FIFA likes to do with the World Cup is arrive in a country, kind of claim territory, set its own rules, plaster everything in its own insignia and its own sponsors,
sentences.zh: 把那个地方变成“国际足联乐园”，在那里一切看起来都一样，你知道自己身处何处，因为一切都是国际足联的。

sentences.en: and turn that place into FIFA land, where everything kind of looks the same and you know exactly where you are because everything is FIFA.
sentences.zh: “国际足联乐园”，就像迪士尼乐园那样？

sentences.en: FIFA land as in, like, Disneyland?
sentences.zh: 什么是“国际足联乐园”？

sentences.en: Like, what's FIFA land?
sentences.zh: “国际足联乐园”介于主题公园和一种奇怪的现实模拟之间。

sentences.en: FIFA land is kind of a cross between a theme park and a weird simulacrum of reality.
sentences.zh: 就像你过去一个月里所经历的现实。

sentences.en: Like the reality you've been living in for the past month.
sentences.zh: 是的，差不多。

sentences.en: Yeah, kind of.
sentences.zh: 这就是国际足联在这里比在其他任何地方都能做到的事情。

sentences.en: And this is the thing that FIFA have been able to do here more than anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 显然，上届世界杯是在俄罗斯举办的，那也是一个威权国家，但它是在莫斯科和圣彼得堡这样的城市举办的，

sentences.en: Obviously, the last World Cup was in Russia, which was also an authoritarian state, but it was also held in cities like Moscow and St. Petersburg,
sentences.zh: 普通人在那里试图正常生活，

sentences.en: where ordinary people are trying to go about their business
sentences.zh: 即使这场大型赛事就在他们面前展开。

sentences.en: even as this mega event is unfolding in front of them.
sentences.zh: 这很复杂，因为你知道，那些人需要去上班。

sentences.en: And that's complicated because, you know, those people want to get to work.
sentences.zh: 他们需要送孩子上学。

sentences.en: They want to get to school.
sentences.zh: 他们有自己的事情要做。

sentences.en: They've got things to do.
sentences.zh: 他们不一定需要把自己的城市交给成群结队的旅行球迷。

sentences.en: They don't necessarily need to give their city over to hordes of traveling soccer fans.
sentences.zh: 而在多哈，这不成问题。

sentences.en: Whereas in Doha, that hasn't been a problem.
sentences.zh: 多哈的学校已经关闭了六周。

sentences.en: The schools have been shut in Doha for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 大多数办公室在锦标赛期间都关闭了。

sentences.en: Most offices have closed for the duration of the tournament.
sentences.zh: 对于国际足联来说，这本质上是一张白纸。

sentences.en: This has been for FIFA essentially a blank canvas.
sentences.zh: 多哈的大片区域都是为锦标赛而建的。

sentences.en: Huge stretches of Doha have been built for the tournament.
sentences.zh: 卢塞尔本身就是为了锦标赛而整体建造的。

sentences.en: Lusail itself has been built in its entirety for the tournament.
sentences.zh: 没有任何反对意见。

sentences.en: There's no objection.
sentences.zh: 他们能做的事情没有限制。

sentences.en: There's no limit to what they can do.
sentences.zh: 金钱不是问题。

sentences.en: Money has been no object.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上拥有的是最纯粹形式的“国际足联乐园”。

sentences.en: And so what we have had is effectively the purest form of FIFA land.
sentences.zh: 那么对你来说，那个“国际足联乐园”是什么样的？

sentences.en: And what does that FIFA land look like for you?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你已经在里面生活了一个月了。

sentences.en: I mean, you've been living in it for the past month.
sentences.zh: 到处都是围栏，因为你在某些时间不能朝某些方向行走。

sentences.en: There's a lot of fences everywhere because you're not allowed to walk in certain directions at certain times.
sentences.zh: 有很多像“现在就是一切”和“团结”这样空洞的口号，我想，它们本意是激励你。

sentences.en: There's lots of vaguely vapid slogans like now is all and together that are meant, I think, to inspire you.
sentences.zh: 但感觉有点像《1984》。

sentences.en: But it feels just a little bit 1984.
sentences.zh: 到处都是音乐。

sentences.en: There's music everywhere.
sentences.zh: 没有一刻是安静、静止或安宁的。

sentences.en: There is no point at which it's quiet or still or restful.
sentences.zh: 这只是一场持续不断的声光和刺激的轰炸。

sentences.en: It is just a constant barrage of sound and light and stimulation.
sentences.zh: 这似乎就是国际足联所设计的，也是他们想要的，他们能够用自己的画笔描绘这座城市、这个国家。

sentences.en: And that seems to be what FIFA have designed and what FIFA have wanted, that they have been able to paint this city, this country, with their own brush.
sentences.zh: 他们把它变成了他们心目中世界杯应有的终极愿景，这并不一定是卡塔尔的，甚至不一定是阿拉伯的。

sentences.en: They've turned it into their ultimate vision of what the World Cup should look like, which is not necessarily Qatari or even Arabian, really.
sentences.zh: 它是国际化的。

sentences.en: It's international.
sentences.zh: 它是脱离现实的。

sentences.en: It's disembodied.
sentences.zh: 很多音乐都是西方的。

sentences.en: A lot of the music is Western.
sentences.zh: 大部分音乐都是西方的，或者至少带有西方色彩。

sentences.en: Most of the music is Western or at least Western-inflected.
sentences.zh: 很多广告都是西方品牌的。

sentences.en: A lot of the adverts are for Western brands.
sentences.zh: 所有的广告，即使是卡塔尔或阿拉伯品牌的广告，也都有西方名人和足球运动员的身影。

sentences.en: All of the adverts, even for Qatari or Arabian brands, feature Western celebrities and particularly footballers.
sentences.zh: 它既无处不在，又仿佛虚无缥缈。

sentences.en: It's kind of everywhere and nowhere all at once.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，这届世界杯就像是国际足联的概念验证，对吧？

sentences.en: In a way, it's like this World Cup was proof of concept for FIFA, right?
sentences.zh: 他们可以与卡塔尔这样的地方合作，而且效果很好。

sentences.en: That they could partner with a place like Qatar and it would be fine.
sentences.zh: 事实上，甚至会更好。

sentences.en: In fact, it would actually be better.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你不必担心那些会拖慢进程的讨厌的民主问题。

sentences.en: You know, you don't have to worry about all of that kind of pesky democracy stuff that slows things down.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Without a shadow of a doubt.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的情况是，这是阿拉伯世界穆斯林占多数的国家举办的第一届世界杯。

sentences.en: We're now in a situation where this is the first World Cup in the Arab world in a Muslim-majority country.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，花了92年时间。

sentences.en: And the first, that's taken 92 years.
sentences.zh: 可能再过八年我们就会回来了。

sentences.en: It may only be eight years before we're back.
sentences.zh: 2030年的比赛是世界杯百年纪念。

sentences.en: The 2030 competition is the World Cup centenary.
sentences.zh: 在足球权势人物中，尤其是球迷中，一直有一种感觉，即理所当然地，

sentences.en: And there's always been a sense among soccer's power brokers and particularly, I think, amongst fans that by right,
sentences.zh: 那届锦标赛应该在南美举办，特别是在阿根廷和乌拉圭。

sentences.en: that tournament should be held in South America and particularly in Argentina and Uruguay.
sentences.zh: 乌拉圭是1930年第一届世界杯的举办地。

sentences.en: Uruguay was the venue for the first World Cup in 1930.
sentences.zh: 那年的决赛是在乌拉圭和阿根廷之间进行的。

sentences.en: And the final that year was between Uruguay and Argentina.
sentences.zh: 但我认为现阶段，热门人选可能必须是沙特阿拉伯。

sentences.en: But I think at this stage, the favorite probably has to be Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼今年在世界杯上频频露面。

sentences.en: Mohammed bin Salman, the crown prince, has been a visible presence at the World Cup this year.
sentences.zh: 他与国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺关系密切。

sentences.en: He has a relationship with Gianni Infantino, the FIFA president.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯近年来在体育领域投入巨资。

sentences.en: And Saudi Arabia has invested heavily in sports in recent years.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是收购英超球队纽卡斯尔联，还有LIV高尔夫巡回赛、分裂的高尔夫巡回赛和一级方程式赛车。

sentences.en: It's not just the purchase of a Premier League team, Newcastle United, but also the Live Golf Tour, the Breakaway Golf Tour and Formula One.
sentences.zh: 沙特阿拉伯看到了体育能为一个面临国际批评的国家和政权带来什么，这不仅是因为也门正在进行的战争，

sentences.en: Saudi Arabia has seen what sport can do for a country and a regime that's faced international criticism, not only over the ongoing war in Yemen,
sentences.zh: 还因为贾迈勒·卡舒吉的谋杀案。

sentences.en: but over the murder of Jamal Khashoggi.
sentences.zh: 这是沙特剧本的一部分。

sentences.en: This is part of Saudi's playbook.
sentences.zh: 沙特不仅有钱举办一场壮观的锦标赛，而且它还为国际足联提供了建立“国际足联乐园”的机会。

sentences.en: And Saudi not only has the money, of course, to stage a spectacular tournament, but it also offers FIFA that chance to build a FIFA land.
sentences.zh: 当然，沙特不仅有钱举办一场壮观的锦标赛，而且它还为国际足联提供了建立“国际足联乐园”的机会。

sentences.en: It would be a blank slate.
sentences.zh: 那将是一张白纸。

sentences.en: It would be another set of new stadiuMs.
sentences.zh: 那将是又一批全新的体育场。

sentences.en: It would be a city turned over to FIFA's whims and desires.
sentences.zh: 那将是一座任由国际足联摆布和支配的城市。

sentences.en: And I think what we've seen from this tournament is that FIFA knows exactly how it wants the World Cup to look.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们从这次锦标赛中看到的是，国际足联非常清楚它想要世界杯呈现出什么样的面貌。

sentences.en: And it's likely to want to take it to a place that allows it to do that again, with the added benefit that Qatar and FIFA have, as you say,
sentences.zh: 它很可能会选择一个能让它再次实现这一目标的地方，而且还有一个额外的好处，正如你所说，卡塔尔和国际足联已经，

sentences.en: ridden the storm of the migrant worker deaths, of the treatment of migrant workers, and of the issues around equality and particularly gay rights.
sentences.zh: 挺过了关于外籍劳工死亡、外籍劳工待遇，以及围绕平等问题，特别是同性恋权利问题的风暴。

sentences.en: FIFA may well feel that seal has been broken and that there is now no reason not to take the tournament to Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 国际足联很可能觉得这层窗户纸已经被捅破了，现在没有理由不把锦标赛带到沙特阿拉伯。

sentences.en: It works for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说行得通。

sentences.en: There are questions for the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 但我们其他人还有疑问。

sentences.en: It puts a lot of soccer fans in a difficult position.
sentences.zh: 这让很多足球迷陷入了困境。

sentences.en: It forces soccer itself, really, to confront issues over how important it feels itself to be.
sentences.zh: 这实际上迫使足球运动本身去面对关于它认为自己有多重要的问题。

sentences.en: What cost is worth having a World Cup?
sentences.zh: 举办世界杯的代价是什么？

sentences.en: I don't think there's any reason to believe that FIFA, from now on, will spend any time at all thinking about those questions.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有任何理由相信国际足联从今往后会花任何时间去思考这些问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So to the question of what we're willing to accept, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以回到我们愿意接受什么的问题上，你知道，

sentences.en: we started this World Cup with stories of Qatar's rocky path and we're ending it on this image of Messi's triumphant win and a proven blueprint, really, in a lot of ways, for FIFA.
sentences.zh: 我们以卡塔尔艰难的申办之路的故事开启了这届世界杯，而我们现在以梅西夺冠的画面结束，在很多方面，这确实是国际足联行之有效的蓝图。

sentences.en: So I guess, Rory, at the end of this tournament, what are we left with?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，罗里，在锦标赛结束时，我们留下了什么？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in front of this enormous kind of golden bowl of Lucille Stadium,
sentences.zh: 我正坐在卢塞尔体育场这个巨大的金色碗状建筑前，

sentences.en: and it's really hard not to look at it and think that the whole idea was for the glamour of the occasion,
sentences.zh: 很难不看着它并认为这一切的初衷就是为了场合的浮华，

sentences.en: for the spectacle that FIFA and Qatar have put on, to dazzle everybody and make us all forget the cost of being here, the way we got here.
sentences.zh: 为了国际足联和卡塔尔所呈现的奇观，去让所有人眼花缭乱，让我们忘记来到这里的代价，以及我们走到这一步的方式。

sentences.en: A little to my right, there used to be a wall that was composed of thousands of photos of the migrant workers who'd worked on building this stadium.
sentences.zh: 在我的右侧一点，曾经有一面墙，上面贴着成千上万张参与建造这座体育场的外籍劳工的照片。

sentences.en: And it was one of those things that Qatar had done that seemed to acknowledge the human cost of this tournament.
sentences.zh: 那是卡塔尔所做的、似乎承认了这次锦标赛的人力成本的事情之一。

sentences.en: And then we got here for the first or second game and it had been painted over with FIFA branding.
sentences.zh: 然后我们来到这里参加第一场或第二场比赛时，它已经被国际足联的品牌宣传画覆盖了。

sentences.en: And that felt like a fairly obvious metaphor for the tournament, that ultimately the World Cup begins, the biggest show on earth, and everything else is forgotten.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是对这次锦标赛一个相当明显的隐喻，最终世界杯开始了，这是地球上最盛大的表演，而其他一切都被遗忘了。

sentences.en: And that is a really uncomfortable truth to confront.
sentences.zh: 这是一个面对起来非常不舒服的事实。

sentences.en: I think it's really hard to leave Qatar without that sensation, that the controversies that we thought we'd face throughout this tournament ultimately were silenced by the sport.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果不带着这种感觉离开卡塔尔真的很难，那就是我们以为在整个锦标赛中会面临的争议，最终都被体育运动所掩盖了。

sentences.en: And that is the power of sport.
sentences.zh: 这就是体育的力量。

sentences.en: It's why Qatar wanted to host the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 这就是卡塔尔想要举办世界杯的原因。

sentences.en: It's why it was prepared to risk all of the reputational damage of the last 12 years,
sentences.zh: 这就是它准备冒着过去12年所有声誉受损风险的原因，

sentences.en: because it knew it would arrive eventually at this moment where it would get its shot of Lionel Messi lifting the World Cup
sentences.zh: 因为它知道最终会迎来这一刻，它将获得利昂内尔·梅西举起世界杯的镜头，

sentences.en: and it would have the world a guard at what it had just seen.
sentences.zh: 并且会让全世界对刚刚看到的一切感到惊叹。

sentences.en: That's why all of this has happened.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一切发生的原因。

sentences.en: And it's hard to avoid thinking that really ultimately at the end kind of worked out for Qatar and for FIFA.
sentences.zh: 很难不认为，最终这对卡塔尔和国际足联来说确实奏效了。

sentences.en: Rory, thank you.
sentences.zh: 罗里，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, the trial of five members of the Proud Boys, a far-right group involved in the storming of the Capitol on January 6th,
sentences.zh: 周一，五名“骄傲男孩”成员的审判即将开始，这是一个参与了1月6日冲击国会大厦事件的极右翼组织，

sentences.en: is set to begin, with jury selection happening in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 陪审团的选择工作正在华盛顿特区进行。

sentences.en: The five defendants face charges of seditious conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 这五名被告面临煽动阴谋罪的指控。

sentences.en: Prosecutors intend to argue that, in inciting the crowd to violence,
sentences.zh: 检察官打算辩称，在煽动人群暴力时，

sentences.en: the defendants aimed to stop the lawful transfer of power and ensure that President Donald Trump remained in office.
sentences.zh: 被告旨在阻止权力的合法移交，并确保唐纳德·特朗普总统继续留任。

sentences.en: The case comes less than a month after Stuart Rhodes, the leader of another far-right group, the Oath Keepers, was convicted on similar charges.
sentences.zh: 此案发生不到一个月前，另一个极右翼组织“誓言守护者”的领导人斯图尔特·罗兹因类似指控被定罪。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko in Asta Tatarvedi, with help from Carlos Prieto.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科和阿斯塔·塔塔维迪制作，卡洛斯·普列托提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Mark George, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治剪辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹维克创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
